sections.title: Book orientation
sections.text: The catalogue describes a formal approach to stylistic change: styles are represented by shape grammars and changes through transformations of those grammars.

sections.title: What the contents promise
sections.text: The sequence moves from traditional accounts of style to grammar normal form, recursive structures and transformations, followed by studies of Greek meander motifs, De Stijl paintings and Wright houses.

sections.title: Review boundary
sections.text: These are catalogue-level descriptions, not findings verified across the book. No experimental methodology or validation result is claimed here.

sections.title: Suggested use
sections.text: Read the theory chapters before the case studies. The separately reviewed 1983 articles provide accessible background, but cannot substitute for checking this later book’s treatment.
